summary: Lattice (built combinations frame + save/load snapshot persistence) and LatticeIndex (partition-key routing over multiple lattices with load-time ambiguity validation). Largest module in the package.
lifecycle_notes: Lattice.save/load added: parquet + manifest.yaml snapshot round-trip (a superset of babel's LatticeManifest) — the prior profile's coverage.md flagged 'no serialisation protocol' as an open question; that gap is now closed. 'Build offline, save, serve apply from load.'
Lattice.is_composed added to distinguish build() output (has __prime_product) from flat/imported lattices.

LatticeIndex routes CONTEXT_KEY-partitioned contexts via ternary and specificity semantics through an embedded filter engine. index(lattices, validate=True, max_witnesses=1_000_000) checks ambiguity using a bounded witness matrix; it raises above the limit rather than sampling.
No-key routing bypasses the metadata routing engine; applying the selected lattice still requires at least one constraint dimension in the shared filter engine.

apply_batch evaluates partition frames separately, concatenates survivors and constructs a fresh BatchRuleResult. Its wrapper does not forward the per-partition selection_info; filter batch guarantees must not be assumed to cover the entire routing wrapper.
documentation_hooks: mountainash-rules-babel docs/lattice-schema.md (export schema contract for save/load)
risks: Lattice.load carries a documented '# allow:' backend-purity exemption for the parquet read, pending backend-agnostic parquet.read_table support in mountainash.
Caller context IDs reach per-partition evaluate_batch calls; global validation across different partitions is not established by those calls alone.
The partitioned apply_batch path has distinct empty-input, merged-order and selection-metadata handling from the direct filter path; those boundaries were inspected, not executed in this profile run.

evidence.detail: Lattice.save/load; LatticeIndex._validate_ambiguity, apply and apply_batch, including no-key dispatch and the final BatchRuleResult construction.
